title: ‘Powerful move’ looms for Bitcoin price, says Bollinger Bands indicator
summary: Bitcoin’s technical indicators predicted a significant move ahead for BTC, but the price must first break resistance at $80,000.

title: Coinbase shifts New York prediction markets fight to federal court
summary: Coinbase legal chief Paul Grewal says the company removed New York’s prediction markets lawsuit to federal court, setting up a sharper fight over CFTC authority and state gambling laws.

title: Bitcoin Bull Score hits six-month high as 2022 bear-market fears linger
summary: Bitcoin price metrics saw a broad recovery in April, but analysis warns that the 2022 bear-market breakdown could still repeat.

title: Another DeFi protocol hacked as Sui-based Volo hit by $3.5M exploit
summary: Volo Protocol has confirmed a $3.5 million exploit affecting select vaults, adding that it has frozen assets and started fund recovery efforts amid ongoing investigation.

title: Uzbekistan creates state-backed crypto mining zone with tax breaks
summary: Uzbekistan has created a supervised crypto mining zone in Karakalpakstan, allowing foreign sales while requiring proceeds to flow through local bank accounts.

title: Stratiphy reopens tax-free route to crypto ETNs for UK investors
summary: Stratiphy is reopening a tax-free route to crypto ETNs in the UK after HMRC’s ISA rule change left retail investors with little practical access.

title: AI drives surge in ‘bug bounty’ reports, but ‘slop’ is rising too
summary: HackerOne, one of the largest bug bounty platforms in the world, reported there were 85,000 valid bounty submissions in 2025, up 7% from the previous year.

title: Privacy protocol Umbra shuts front end to stifle Kelp exploiters
summary: Umbra has shut down its front end to stop hackers, but says it can’t stop the use of its smart contracts or another version of its open-source front end.

title: US law firm apologizes after AI hallucinations made it to legal filing
summary: Sullivan & Cromwell’s Andrew Dietderich said the company has AI policies to prevent incorrect citations and other errors, but procedures weren’t followed on this occasion.

title: Coinbase highlights Algorand, Aptos' work to mitigate quantum threat
summary: Coinbase’s quantum advisory board says quantum computing isn’t yet a threat, but has urged for upgrade work to begin, with some blockchains being less prepared than others.
